title: Influence of coating thickness on residual stress and adhesion-strength of cold-sprayed Inconel 718 coatings

preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: grit blasted with commercially available alumina grit with an average particle size of 420–600 μm prior to deposition.

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: CGT-Oerlikon Metco Kinetics® 8000 highpressure cold spray system

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: coatings are uniform and free of large voids and cracks. very dense granular like microstructure with unobservable oxidation of the coating material

Experiments.Notes: 216 μm thick sample. The feedstock powder was one that was based on the chemical composition of IN 718, but not exactly, and there are details on the powder in reference 35. samples used for adhesion strength tests were deposited on a thicker substrate (5.5 mm). thickness of sample varied by increasing number of passes from 2-13 passes.
